info.title: RapidPro / TextIt REST API v2
info.description: RapidPro / TextIt REST API v2: 31 endpoints under /api/v2/ with a .json suffix, token auth (`Authorization: Token <key>`), cursor-paginated DRF envelopes ({ next, previous, results }), and create-or-update by POST with a ?uuid= (or ?key=/?urn=) lookup. Authored from RapidPro's own route table and the endpoint docs rendered from its view docstrings (nyaruka/rapidpro temba/api/v2). The OpenFn rapidpro adaptor's named functions POST to contacts, flow_starts and broadcasts; the rest of the API is reachable from a workflow over HTTP with the same host and token.
